selected_evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin may schedule cron jobs on node1
selected_evidence.summary: The exact allow-list and permissions were captured. Functional tests showed opsadmin succeeded, unlisted user antrieb was denied, and root retained access.
opsadmin was created and remained present after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, new boot ID a0498f79-fc3a-4afe-8dff-51b45cc3c400 observed, and crond plus the persisted access policy were verified after recovery.

commands.command:
printf 'node=%s ip=%s
' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /etc/redhat-release; id root; id opsadmin 2>&1 || true; systemctl is-active crond; systemctl is-enabled crond; ls -l /etc/cron.allow /etc/cron.deny 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- cron.allow'; sed -n '1,120p' /etc/cron.allow 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- cron.deny'; sed -n '1,120p' /etc/cron.deny 2>&1 || true

commands.command: id; sudo -n true; printf 'sudo_rc=%s\n' "$?"; command -v crontab; rpm -q cronie
sudo -n useradd -m opsadmin && id opsadmin && getent passwd opsadmin

printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null && sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cron.allow && sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/cron.allow && sudo -n restorecon /etc/cron.allow && sudo -n ls -lZ /etc/cron.allow && sudo -n sed -n '1,20p' /etc/cron.allow

sudo -n -u opsadmin sh -c "printf '17 3 * * * /bin/true # access-control-verification
' | /usr/bin/crontab -"; ops_rc=$?; printf 'opsadmin_install_rc=%s
' "$ops_rc"; sudo -n -u opsadmin /usr/bin/crontab -l; printf 'opsadmin_list_rc=%s
' "$?"; printf '23 4 * * * /bin/true # must-be-denied
' | /usr/bin/crontab - 2>&1; denied_rc=$?; printf 'antrieb_install_rc=%s
' "$denied_rc"; sudo -n /usr/bin/crontab -l >/tmp/root-cron-check.out 2>/tmp/root-cron-check.err; root_rc=$?; printf 'root_access_rc=%s
' "$root_rc"; sed -n '1,10p' /tmp/root-cron-check.out; sed -n '1,10p' /tmp/root-cron-check.err; test "$ops_rc" -eq 0 && test "$denied_rc" -ne 0 && test "$root_rc" -le 1
